answer: An attacker running 159 aliases therefore needs 184 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in ridge, expire in tide, and relic lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2825 identities would post 3007 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
